meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后，每当界面被构建或修改，Claude 会先捕获网页或终端界面的截图/文本证据，用脚本算出像素差异，再让两个只读审查员分别检查设计系统/功能与视觉保真/CJK 问题，最后给出“通过/需修改”的结论。
howto.when: 当提到“视觉QA”、“像素对比”或“界面看起来不对”等关键词时，或在你构建/修改任何界面后，Claude 就会接管进行视觉审查。

say.text: 帮我检查这个页面看起来对不对
say.note: Claude 会截图并跑完整视觉审查，给出结论。

say.text: 对比参考图和当前界面的像素差异
say.note: 会生成差异热区并指派审查员评估。

say.text: 检查这个终端界面边框有没有对齐
say.note: 会捕获终端文本并检查宽度和对齐。

howto.what_en: After installation, whenever a UI is built or changed, Claude captures screenshots or terminal text evidence, computes pixel diffs with bundled scripts, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK), and synthesizes a pass/revise verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions visual QA, pixel diff, or UI looks wrong keywords, or after any UI build/change.

say_en.text: Check if this page looks right.
say_en.note: Claude screenshots and runs a full visual QA pass.

say_en.text: Compare pixel diff between reference and current UI.
say_en.note: It generates hotspots and dispatches reviewers.

say_en.text: Check if this terminal UI borders align.
say_en.note: It captures terminal text and validates width and alignment.
